summary: Verified core production testing principles including regression protection across critical contracts, flaky test identification and stress detection, and catastrophic risks of database leakage.
evidence: Production protection: automated validation of revenue paths (302 redirects), security boundaries (IDOR 404), and data integrity (worker idempotency)
Flakiness detection: consecutive stress loops (20-50x), CI retry telemetry, and diagnosing unawaited promises, clock drift, and shared database state
Real database risks: catastrophic TRUNCATE data loss, synthetic data pollution skewing customer analytics, and connection pool exhaustion
